svg.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: EDI Simulator architecture
svg.desc: Ten fictional farm producers send ANSI X12 832/846/856 over FTP to the Harvest Hub distributor, which validates, acknowledges (TA1/997), maps to JSON, ingests and delivers inventory over REST to the Harvest Market order app. RabbitMQ carries EDI notifications, order events and platform events. The FTP server is a highly available cluster: an HAProxy load balancer in front of three vsftpd nodes on one shared storage volume, healed by a platform controller and monitored by Prometheus; the EDI Control Center Platform area reads both.
svg.text: ANSI X12 004010 B2B flow · all companies, people and data are fictional · everything runs locally with docker compose
envelope trace · X12 ⇄ JSON · validation · FTP transfers · deliveries
reports · KPIs · X12 Inspector · Platform: FTP cluster & storage
